tasks.title: Third-party call allowlist
tasks.objective: Implement allowlist check logic in src/installer/allowlist.py with function check_url_allowed(url: str, allowed_domains: list[str]) -> bool. Returns True if the URL's hostname strictly matches or is a subdomain of an allowed domain, otherwise False. Raises ValueError if url is malformed.
acceptance_criteria: Correctly validates subdomains and exact matches

tasks.title: Record-and-continue integrity quarantine
tasks.objective: Implement digest verification and quarantine in src/installer/quarantine.py with function verify_artifact(file_path: str, expected_sha256: str) -> bool. Computes the SHA-256 digest of the file at file_path, compares it to expected_sha256, returns True if match, or logs/records the failure and returns False without halting batch processing.
acceptance_criteria: Returns True on correct hash, False on mismatch without raising exception

tasks.title: Transactional placement with rollback
tasks.objective: Implement transactional placement in src/installer/transaction.py with class InstallTransaction managing a staged copy of files into target directories. Method commit() finalizes installation; method rollback() reverses all staged file placements upon failure. Raises RuntimeError if commit fails.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback successfully restores prior state on failure

tasks.title: Manifest resolution and HTTPS downloader
tasks.objective: Implement manifest resolution and HTTPS download in src/installer/resolver.py with function resolve_and_download(manifest: dict, target_dir: str) -> list[str]. Resolves dependencies, fetches artifacts over HTTPS, and returns list of downloaded file paths.
acceptance_criteria: Downloads artifacts over HTTPS respecting allowlist

tasks.title: Service pattern API and channel registry
tasks.objective: Implement service-pattern API and static channel registry in src/installer/service.py using Service.method naming conventions and a handler registry. Expose register_channel(channel_name: str, handler: callable) and dispatch(channel_name: str, payload: dict) -> Any. Raises KeyError if channel is unregistered.
acceptance_criteria: Supports static pairable channel registry and Service.method routing

tasks.title: End-to-end installer orchestration
tasks.objective: Implement end-to-end installer orchestrator in src/installer/orchestrator.py with function run_install(manifest: dict, target_dir: str, allowed_domains: list[str]) -> bool. Combines resolution, allowlist checks, quarantine verification, and transactional placement with rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Executes full installation workflow with integrity checks and rollback support
